name: Llama 3.2 1B
notes: The lightest useful option. Surprisingly decent for simple chat; ideal for very limited hardware.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B
notes: Minimal coder. Fast autocomplete on old hardware; limited for reasoning about large refactors.

name: Gemma 2 2B
notes: Good text quality for its size. Use it when Llama 3.2 3B runs too slowly.

name: Llama 3.2 3B
notes: The best 'minimal generalist'. An honest starting point for 8GB laptops.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder 3B
notes: A small coder that punches above its size. Good balance on 8GB laptops.

name: Phi-3 Mini 3.8B
notes: Reasons better than average for its size. Useful when a 7B doesn't fit but you need code help.

name: Gemma 3 4B
notes: Long context and solid multilingual support. A good RAG base on modest hardware.

name: Mistral 7B
notes: The 7B classic: fast and consistent. A good generalist when you need no specialization.

name: Qwen2.5 7B
notes: Strong generalist, especially good at following instructions and in Spanish.

name: Llama 3.1 8B
notes: The reference 8B. Very good at RAG and summarization; the sensible default with 16GB of RAM.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder 7B
notes: The reference local coder. Autocomplete, explanation and real refactors.

name: DeepSeek-R1 Distill 7B
notes: Step-by-step reasoning (chain-of-thought) at a local size. Slower, but deeper.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder 14B
notes: A real quality jump for code with 16GB+. The quality/size sweet spot for developers.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder 32B
notes: Code quality close to cloud models. Needs 32GB+ of RAM to run comfortably.

name: Llama 3.1 70B
notes: The local ceiling. Only viable with 64GB+ of RAM or a serious GPU — most people can't run it.
